title: A hand crossing into FIXME writes the fixme list it journals
intention: A ticket sent back to FIXME by the one crossing command carries, on the ticket itself, the list of what it lacks that the crossing journaled, so its FIXME exit gate is answerable without a hand repair.
why: Measured 2026-10-13 by the builder on e038544a9b60: cairn/tools/base/cross.py cross() journals --missing on the emit into FIXME (cross.py:62-67) but writes only workflow_and_state back to the ticket; the ticket's fixme list is written only by clearance (cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/clearance.py:1126). The FIXME exit gate inspect_fixme (cairn/tools/base/transitions.py:1160) then reads 'stands at FIXME with no fixme list' and the boat cannot leave FIXME without a hand repair through the artifact door.
traces_to: Law 4 (the FIXME gate's answerability is physics at the one crossing command, not a hand repair someone remembers) and Law 7 (a record of truth carries what the journal says).
how: cairn/tools/base/cross.py only: in cross(), when the canonical target is FIXME, (a) refuse with ValueError when missing is empty ('a crossing into FIXME names what is missing: --missing <what>'), before emit; (b) in the same write-back that sets workflow_and_state, set t['fixme'] = [{'n': i, 'kind': 'cross', 'missing': m} for i, m in enumerate(missing, 1)], the shape clearance.py:1126 writes. Other targets are unchanged.
falsifier: cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_hand_crossing_into_fixme_writes_its_list.py under PROVES {'5a2a8f45177a': {'1','2','3'}} over a scratch tickets dir, node_classes and owning charter: (1) cross(id, 'FIXME', missing=['a','b']) leaves the ticket with fixme == [{'n':1,'kind':'cross','missing':'a'},{'n':2,'kind':'cross','missing':'b'}] and the cursor at FIXME; (2) cross(id, 'FIXME') with no missing raises ValueError and writes nothing (ticket bytes and the component's journal unchanged); (3) a cross to a non-FIXME summons writes no fixme key. Hollow: today's cross.py reds 1 and 2.

decisions.text: The fixme entries take kind 'cross' so a reader can tell a hand kick-back from clearance's measured lacks. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
A FIXME crossing without --missing is refused rather than defaulted: an empty list is the unanswerable gate this ticket removes. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
